Union Tube Transistor browse by type volume/amplification amplification treble booster browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Union Tube Transistor Tone Druid - Overdrive Published on January 23, 2018 Union Tube Transistor overdrive treble boost pedal Information Union Tube & Transistor The Tone Druid is our first stand alone overdrive. Those familiar with our MORE will find similar tones here. The Tone Druid takes the sound of a MORE hitting a 12ax7 and adds a master volume to tame. Maximum clean boost is +10db, but it can get much louder as gain is added.
